title: Compact numeric presets + auditable calibration pipeline for model catalog
creator: Anika Rao
description: Design and implement a lightweight, auditable set of numeric presets (FP8 / INT8) per-model in the catalog plus a repeatable calibration pipeline that produces validated profiles and safety guardrails. This ticket covers the engineering work to author the calibration runner, CI/validation gates, and the runtime-safe metadata (presets + fallback chains) that the model catalog surface will expose.
background: Customers expect predictable latency/cost improvements from lower-precision inference but unpredictable accuracy regressions are a major risk. Existing work focuses on broad quant presets; we need a lean, model-level artifact that is both conservative by default and auditable, provides reproducible calibration traces, and plugs into our rollout/rollback machinery.
goals: Create a compact per-model preset format that encodes FP8/INT8 candidate profiles and safe fallback chains
Build a reproducible calibration runner that emits calibration artifacts (stat snapshots, error profiles, seed/fingerprint)
Add CI gating in model onboarding that enforces quantitative accuracy thresholds and generates an audit report
Ship runtime hooks so presets can be applied with automatic rollback on drift or SLO degradation
success_criteria: Every new model in catalog has a default 'compact preset' artifact produced by calibration runner
Calibration artifacts include a deterministic dataset fingerprint and per-layer stats sufficient for re-calibration
Offline validation shows <= 1.5% loss in accuracy vs FP16 baseline for INT8 presets on representative eval sets (tighter for FP8 where applicable)
Runtime rollout supports canary shadowing and automatic fallback to safe preset within 5 minutes of detection
proposal: Introduce a compact preset spec (jsonl key-value list) that contains: candidate precision (FP8/INT8), per-tensor scale hints, expected tokenization / seq_len envelope, validation metrics, and a fingerprint hash. Implement a calibration runner that computes per-layer quant stats, runs a small held-out eval suite, and outputs a signed artifact stored in the catalog. Add a lightweight CI job to validate artifacts against acceptance criteria and surface an audit report link.
calibration_workflow: 1) Select stratified calibration shards using workload fingerprints; 2) Collect activation histograms and per-channel min/max and MSE stats with deterministic RNG seeds; 3) Run PTQ flow variants (symmetric/asymmetric, per-channel/per-tensor) and record outputs; 4) Evaluate candidates on the validation harness (few-shot and full eval slices); 5) Emit compact preset with metrics, recommended runtime flags, and recommended fallback chain; 6) Sign and store artifact in model catalog for consumption by runtime and console.
validation_plan: Offline: run the candidate preset across the model's existing eval suite and focused adversarial slices, capture ROUGE/BLEU/semantic similarity and calibration drift metrics. Shadow: run preset in shadow mode on 1-5% production traffic for 48-72 hours and compare per-request deltas; require no more than configured accuracy regression thresholds. CI gating: PRs that change presets must include validation artifacts and must pass a regression check. Failure mode: automatic mark as 'unsafe' and block rollout.
rollout_strategy: Stage 1: catalog-only — presets generated but not applied. Stage 2: shadow canary on dedicated infra with 1% request duplication. Stage 3: progressive canary (5% -> 20% -> 50%) with automated metric checks at each step. Stage 4: full rollout with monitoring, and a 30-minute automatic rollback sentinel if key metrics degrade beyond thresholds.
monitoring_and_observability: Expose per-preset dashboards: token-level latency, cost delta, accuracy delta vs baseline, and sample-based failure examples. Tie artifacts to trace IDs and surface calibration report link on model detail page. Add alert rules for sustained accuracy drift (>X p.p. over Y minutes) and for increased error/timeout rates.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: calibration data not representative -> Mitigation: require dataset fingerprint and a minimum coverage score; block preset if coverage < threshold
Risk: silent accuracy regressions in rare slices -> Mitigation: require adversarial slice evaluation and shadow traffic with manual review for high-risk models
Risk: runtime incompatibility with certain kernels -> Mitigation: include runtime feature flags in preset and a fast validation smoke test before canary
tasks: Spec: author compact preset schema and storage contract
Engine: implement calibration runner and stats collectors
CI: create calibration validation job and gating rules
Runtime: add preset apply/rollback hooks and lightweight smoke tests
Console: show preset audit report and allow manual override
QA: design regression suites and adversarial slices
notes: We should coordinate with Product (PM: Zoe Kim) and Research (lead: Dr. Mateo Alvarez) for acceptance thresholds on generative tasks. This ticket intentionally keeps the presets compact so storage/transfer costs are negligible when applied at scale. Consider an optional extended artifact for deep-dive debugging that is stored off-line behind analytics permission.
